answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the market, with the stake locked for a long vesting period. A new identity that behaves honestly earns its stake back like a pearl forming layer by layer, while a fake identity caught cheating loses the deposit. An attacker who wants to flood the nebula of the network with sock puppets must fund each one, so the cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. The velvet glove is that honest agents pay nothing in the end, only a temporary lockup, while Sybil operators bleed capital on every identity they spin up.
